entityContracts.name: constructor-missing-size
entityContracts.description: rejects configs without itemSize or estimateSize

entityContracts.name: constructor-both-sizes
entityContracts.description: rejects configs that provide both itemSize and estimateSize

fixedMode.name: simple-range
fixedMode.description: computes the range for a simple scroll-offset/viewport-size/itemSize combination

fixedMode.name: default-overscan
fixedMode.description: uses the default overscan when none is supplied

fixedMode.name: overscan-both-sides
fixedMode.description: expands the range on both sides when overscan is set

fixedMode.name: clamp-start
fixedMode.description: clamps start at 0 when scroll offset minus overscan would go negative

fixedMode.name: clamp-end
fixedMode.description: clamps end at count - 1 when scroll offset plus overscan would exceed the list

onRangeChange.name: first-call
onRangeChange.description: fires on the first getRange() call

onRangeChange.name: no-state-change
onRangeChange.description: fires only once when getRange() is called twice with no state change

onRangeChange.name: scroll-moves-range
onRangeChange.description: fires again when the scroll offset moves the range

onRangeChange.name: retained-state-isolated
onRangeChange.description: isolates returned and observed ranges from retained comparison state

onRangeChange.name: throwing-hook
onRangeChange.description: a throwing onRangeChange hook surfaces as a HookInvocationError

onRangeChange.name: async-rejecting-hook
onRangeChange.description: an async-rejecting onRangeChange override is routed through the hook safety net without producing an unhandled rejection

variableMode.name: initial-range
variableMode.description: computes an initial range using estimateSize

variableMode.name: measure-corrects-range
variableMode.description: measureItem corrections change subsequent getRange() results

variableMode.name: overscan-applied
variableMode.description: applies overscan the same way as fixed mode

variableMode.name: measure-same-size-noop
variableMode.description: measureItem ignores repeated measurements with the same size

variableMode.name: variable-count-zero
variableMode.description: variable mode returns an empty range when count is zero

variableMode.name: measure-noop-fixed-mode
variableMode.description: measureItem is a no-op in fixed-size mode

variableMode.name: interleaved-measure-corrections
variableMode.description: computes correct final offsets after interleaved out-of-order measureItem corrections

variableMode.name: variable-boundary-offsets
variableMode.description: handles fractional offset boundaries in variable mode
